description: 7 exemplars + 5 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Re-authored 2026-10-11 when the vector split changed two of its rows and brought it back into the touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover job-shape to provider matching, including the two changed rows — an icon routing question whose routed answer is now NO provider, and complex illustrative vector art, the one shape a vector provider still owns — plus a German phrasing of the plainest routing question. Near-misses are the five neighbours that name a provider or a vector surface and are still somebody else's job: writing the prompt grammar (prompt-engineering-image), invoking an adapter directly, looking up a lifecycle tier (provider-lifecycle-discipline), and the two hand-authoring requests that go to svg-authoring rather than to any provider. Counterexamples guard the two requests that mention an image and ask nothing of routing: a likeness / rights question, and an edit to an existing photo.

welches Bildmodell nehme ich für ein Logo mit Schrift?

queries.note: still a routing question, and after the vector split the routed answer is NO provider — the incumbent set first, then svg-authoring for a glyph it lacks

queries.q: which provider do I use for complex illustrative vector art?
queries.note: the one job shape a vector provider still owns; the answer states the adapter scaffold-tier lifecycle
